name: Young Devour Dragon
_source: Owner scans 2026-11-19; Clash Setup: TTSF Codex (Young Devour Dragon Clash)

footprint.rear: the 3 cells directly behind the footprint

vp.name: Broad Back
vp.text:
Climb: Test Might (10+).
Hold on: End of Monster Round: If on the VP, test Tenacity (12+). Fail: Knockdown, Displace.
Young Devour Dragon starts with the VP unlocked.
[Divine Target] Divine Target cannot move to the VP. When you leave the VP, gain the [Divine Target] Divine Target token.
While on the VP, you have +X [Power], where X is the Level of the attacked BP. If you deal a Wound, gain +1 [P].

traits.name: Falling Skies
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Take the three Phase Trait cards, Flying High (Phase I), Floating Low (Phase II), and Grounded (Phase III), and place them in a stack face up (Flying High on top, Grounded on the bottom). Only the effects of the top card are active.
! When a Knight deals a Wound, do not Escalate!
Exhibition Clash: Remove the Grounded (Phase III) Phase Trait card.

traits.name: Ruined Bastion
traits.text:
Knights may move onto Ruined Wall Terrain tiles during their voluntary movement.
Knights may move onto Tower Terrain tiles from Ruined Wall Terrain tiles or the VP during their voluntary movement.
Knights treat Tower and Ruined Wall Terrain tiles as Indestructible during their involuntary movement.

traits.name: Climbable Appendages
traits.text: Young Devour Dragon starts the Clash with the VP unlocked.

traits.name: Dragonfeast
traits.text: Additional Setup: Add the Your Death Becomes a Dragon's Sacrament Judicium card to the Judicium deck.

traits.name: Groundscraper
traits.text: Ram: The Dragon moves adjacent to the designated Terrain tile. Then, trigger effects based on the current Phase's Trait card.

traits.name: Curse of Endless Hunger
traits.text: End of Monster Round: [Divine Target] Divine Target loses [V] equal to their [P].

traits.name: Inescapable Maw
traits.text: When a Knight is Devoured, place their Portrait card near the Monster Sheet, they cannot be resurrected during that Clash.

traits.name: Flying High (PHASE I)
traits.text:
The Dragon gains +4 To Hit unless attacked from a Terrain tile, the VP, or during a Lunging Attack (see Tower Terrain tile).
The Dragon gains +2 To Hit when attacked from a Ruined Wall Terrain tile.
The Dragon doesn't destroy Terrain tiles and doesn't cause Crash unless stated otherwise.
You fail all Climb tests.
When the Dragon Rams a Tower, each Knight on it suffers Crash.
—
When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 3+ Wounds on the Wound Stack, remove this card and all AI 1 and BP 1 cards from the Clash, except cards on the Wound Stack. Create new AI and BP decks using AI 2 and BP 2 cards. Then, the Dragon performs AI.

traits.name: Floating Low (PHASE II)
traits.text:
The Dragon has +2 To Hit unless attacked from a Terrain tile, the VP, or during a Lunging Attack (see Tower Terrain tile).
The Dragon causes Crash as normal.
When the Dragon Rams a Tower, that Tower is destroyed.
—
When you finish resolving the current action, if there are 6+ Wounds on the Wound Stack:
Exhibition: You win the Clash.
Full Clash: Remove this card and all AI 2 and BP 2 cards from the Clash, except cards on the Wound Stack. Create new AI and BP decks using AI 3 and BP 3 cards. Then, the Dragon performs AI.

traits.name: Grounded (PHASE III)
traits.text:
The Dragon Crash Devours you (you die). If you survive, Displace to the closest Empty Space.
If a Knight with the Called by the Heavens Condition card would draw a Judicium, they are Devoured instead.
+3 to all Climb tests.
When the Dragon Rams a Tower, that Tower is destroyed and all Knights on it are devoured (die).
—
To leave the VP voluntarily, you must pass a Climb Down test (same difficulty as the Climb test).

clashSetup._source: TTSF Codex — Young Devour Dragon Clash
steps: Monster Positioning: Place the Young Devour Dragon miniature on the space designated on the diagram (facing: all-direction marker — random arrow).
Additional Setup: Place the Divine Target token and the Fool's deck near the Monster Sheet. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).
notes: Dragon 3x3 = G8–I10 (방향 표시는 4방향 마커 — 무작위), 기사 시작 칸 G4·E12는 Tower 위, C8은 Ruined Wall 위. 타일·시작 칸은 코덱스 도식에서 읽음 [해석, 확인 필요]

rulings: Bellow of the Famished: 첫 AI로 수행 — 무작위 기사 1명이 Divine Target, 다른 무작위 2명이 Called by the Heavens. 카드를 제거하고 AI 수행

Falling Skies: Wound를 줘도 Escalate하지 않음. Phase I(Flying High) → Wound 3개에서 AI·BP 1을 제거하고 AI·BP 2 덱으로, Phase II(Floating Low) → Wound 6개에서 AI·BP 3 덱으로(Phase III Grounded). 전환할 때마다 Dragon이 AI를 수행. Exhibition Clash(Wound 6개에서 승리)는 이 구현에 없음 — 항상 Full Clash
To Hit: Phase I +4 (Terrain 타일·VP·Lunging Attack에서는 0, Ruined Wall에서는 +2), Phase II +2 (Terrain 타일·VP·Lunging Attack에서는 0), Phase III 보정 없음
Phase I: Dragon은 Terrain을 파괴하지 않고 Crash를 일으키지 않음 — Dragon 아래에 놓이게 된 기사는 가장 가까운 빈 칸으로 Displace만 함 [해석, 확인 필요]. Phase II: 일반 규칙대로 Crash. Phase III: Dragon의 Crash = Devour(사망)
Ram: Dragon이 지정된 Tower에 인접한 위치로 이동(가장 가까운 유효 위치). Phase I: Tower 위의 기사 Crash / II: Tower 파괴(Rubble) / III: Tower 파괴 + 위의 기사 Devour. "Ram the furthest Tower" = Dragon에서 가장 먼 Tower

Ruined Bastion: 기사는 자발적 이동으로 Ruined Wall 위로 올라갈 수 있고, Tower에는 Ruined Wall(또는 같은 Tower)에서만 올라감. 비자발적 이동에서는 Tower·Ruined Wall이 Indestructible. Tower에서 비자발적으로 이동하게 되면 Crash 후 모든 Obstacle을 무시. 이 Clash의 기사 이동은 Bypass 계열 효과를 반영하지 않음 (미구현)
Lunging Attack (Tower): Move + Combat action. Tower에서 Speed만큼 직선으로 이동해 Dragon에 인접한 뒤 공격 — 명중하면 즉시 VP로, 아니면 Knockdown. 이동 경로의 Terrain은 무시 [해석, 확인 필요]

VP (Broad Back): 처음부터 열려 있음. Climb = Might 10+ (Phase I: 모두 실패, Phase III: +3, 내려올 때도 Climb Down 테스트). Hold On = Tenacity 12+ (실패: Knockdown, Displace). Divine Target은 VP로 이동할 수 없고, VP를 떠나면 Divine Target 토큰을 얻음. VP 위: +X Power (X = 공격한 BP의 Level), Wound를 주면 +1 [P]
Called by the Heavens: Tower 위에서 Monster Attack을 받으면 모든 Gated Effect 적용, VP로 이동하면 버림. 턴 종료 시 가장 가까운 Tower 쪽으로 최단 경로 3칸, Tower 위면 +1 [P]
Fool's deck 이동: 카드의 좌표가 Dragon 3x3의 가운데 칸이 되도록 배치(보드 밖이면 안쪽으로 보정) [해석, 확인 필요]
"The Dragon moves N spaces forward": 바라보는 방향으로 한 칸씩, Board Edge에서 멈춤
Zone 도식(작은 그림에서 읽음) [해석, 확인 필요]: Bile Vomit = 정면에서 넓어지는 삼각형 3줄, Tail Lash = 정면 3칸. Black Hole "All spaces in front" = Dragon의 앞쪽 호 전체
Command of the Famishing: Called by the Heavens 획득과 "[P]만큼 [V] 손실"은 명중과 무관하게 적용, 이동과 [P] 획득은 명중 수에 따름 [해석, 확인 필요]
Madness of the Famishing: 명중 시 일어나서 가장 가까운 다른 기사 쪽으로 Speed만큼 이동, 인접하면 Knight Power dice를 3번 굴려 나온 기호 수만큼 그 기사가 [V] 손실 + Peril Check [해석, 확인 필요]

미구현: Lumbering, Exhibition Clash, Hungry Chomp·Fearsome Feast의 "Shield를 active Weapon으로 선언했으면 버림", Snatch 'n' Snap의 Weapon 슬롯 비활성, World Eater의 Talent 카드 버리기, Inescapable Maw(부활 불가 — 현재 Clash 중 부활 효과 없음)

REACT! 창: AI 카드는 인쇄된 위치대로 — Targeting 목록 아래 표시가 있는 카드만 Targeting 뒤 창, 효과 줄 사이 표시는 그 자리, 마지막 효과 줄 뒤 표시는 After Attack / After Final Attack 앞 (스캔 재판독 2026-11-19). Signature·Trait Attack·BP 카드의 REACT! 표시는 재판독 전이라 이전 처리 그대로 [확인 필요]
